Frequently asked questions

Is our communication confidential?

Yes. Everything you share is protected by legal privilege, even if you don't end up instructing us.

Can we meet online?

Yes, by video call. This is common for clients outside Athens or abroad.

Do you take cases outside Athens?

Yes. We represent clients across Greece, working with local colleagues where needed.
